content:
I will conclude tonight by saying that the greatest gift I could receive on my birthday is to be able to stand before each and every one of you and convey in the only words I can how grateful Nancy and I are: thank you for being there and for being here.
今晚我将总结说，我在生日那天收到的最伟大的礼物是能够站在你们每个人面前并传达。我唯一能表达的是，我和南希是多么的感激：谢谢你们的到来，感谢你们的到来。
